{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Mothers for Pokémon.png|thumb|250px|Mothers for Pokémon]] The '''Mothers for Pokémon''', abbreviated as '''M.F.P.''', (Japanese: '''ポケモン大好きママさん''' ''Pokémon Daisuki Mama-san, P.M.D.M.'') are recurring characters who appeared in ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]'' and ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]''. They are a group of wives and mothers who love {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and [[Pokémon Contests]]. There are six known members, and they are based in [[Rubello Town]] in the [[Hoenn]] [[Region|region]]. [[Savannah]] appears to be their leader, as the other members claim that she is their "pride and joy" because she won a [[Ribbon]] before. They seem to be obsessed with famous people, such as [[Drew]] and [[Norman]]. They claim to have pictures of Drew from every Pokémon Contest he has entered. They also have other Drew- and Norman-related merchandise. While Savannah was getting ready for the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] Rubello Contest, the other M.F.P. members were out doing her shopping and other chores.
